At m=5 precisely six exceptions, all S3-images of (1,1,2,6,7), with two upper candidate vectors (0,0,1,3,3,1) and (0,0,0,4,5,1); their exact difference factors as p²(1−p)(1−3p). This proves sharp switch and unique action types for 0<p<1 excluding tie. Finite exhaustion does not generalize to >5.
